name: Microsoft
short_desc: External: Outlook mail and calendar. Quick connect through Composio, or your own Microsoft app.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Connect Outlook mail and calendar (Outlook.com, Hotmail, Microsoft 365). Quick connect goes through Composio, a third party (paste a free Composio API key); or register your own Microsoft Entra app with the app's guided steps. Your agent and apps get mail and calendar tools: search, read, draft, send an approved draft, and list, add, change, delete and answer events.
